abstract: Adnexal masses diagnosed in a gravid woman sometimes must be surgically evaluated and treated during the pregnancy. A laparoscopic approach may have several advantages over laparotomy, but only one case of laparoscopic adnexal surgery during pregnancy has been previously reported. Two pregnant patients with acute pelvic pain and adnexal masses were treated by operative laparoscopy. One patient had a large benign cystic teratoma and the other had torsion of the fallopian tube secondary to a paratubal cyst. Cystectomies were performed in both women, and in the second patient the tube was reduced and conserved. It appears that with proper care of surgical technique and caution to exclude malignancy, laparoscopy may be performed successfully to remove adnexal masses during the second trimester of pregnancy.
abstract_ja: 妊娠中に付属器腫瘤を有する女性に対しては、外科的評価と治療が必要となることがある。腹腔鏡手術は開腹術に比べていくつかの利点を持つ可能性があるが、妊娠中の腹腔鏡下付属器手術の報告は1例のみであった。急性骨盤痛と付属器腫瘤を有する妊婦2例に対し、手術用腹腔鏡を施行した。1例は大きな良性嚢胞性奇形腫であり、もう1例は傍卵管嚢胞に続発した卵管捻転であった。両例とも嚢腫摘出術を施行し、後者では卵管を整復して温存した。適切な手術手技を用い、悪性腫瘍の除外に注意すれば、妊娠中期に付属器腫瘤を除去するための腹腔鏡手術を成功裏に施行しうると考えられる。
